question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Football'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5 is **"football".**
 
• The **entire context** of the paragraph is about Cristiano Ronaldo, who is a well-known football player.
 
• The use of **"football" **completes the sentence correctly, making it clear what sport Ronaldo is paid to play.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: * 'Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, born on February 5th, 1985 and commonly known as Cristiano Ronaldo, is a Portuguese footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Real Madrid and serves as captain of the Portuguese national team. Ronaldo currently holds the distinction of being the most expensive player in football history after having transferred to Real Madrid from Manchester United in a deal worth £80 million (€94m, US$132m). His contract with Real Madrid is believed to have made him the highest-paid **football** player in the world.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's briefly look at all the options:
 
 
• **Rugby:** Rugby is a different sport and Cristiano Ronaldo is not associated with it. He is a footballer, not a rugby player.
 
• **Tennis: **Tennis is a different sport and Cristiano Ronaldo does not play tennis professionally. He is a footballer, not a tennis player.
 
• **Cricket: **Cricket is also a different sport and Cristiano Ronaldo does not play it. He is a footballer, not a cricket player.
